answer: Duplicating an identity means acquiring another marble, which costs real stake and burns a pigment trace peers can audit. Each agent must stake a unique marble token carved from a shared quarry, and the carving is recorded with a pigment signature bound to its on-chain history. Like flowers in a meadow, each bloom needs its own root, so forgery demands repeated capital outlay, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
